Luno is the crypto investment app you can rely on, enabling you to buy, store and explore crypto securely. We’re committed to putting the power of cryptocurrency in everyone's hands, sensibly and responsibly. Since 2013, we’ve helped millions of people around the world invest safely in crypto. All products and cryptocurrencies on our platform must first meet stringent legal, risk and technical security standards.Transparency is key for us. Luno stores all crypto on a 1:1 basis and we have rigorous processes in place so you can be confident your investment is secure. We're available in multiple markets around the world and we work closely with regulators and other key stakeholders to ensure compliance with local laws, as we believe this is the best way to help everyone, everywhere, invest safely.

About the team: 

The People Operations Team forms part of the greater Global People Team within Luno. We are a lean, dynamic, and impactful team always striving to set the standard within our fields of responsibility and expertise. Energised when faced with challenges, we ensure solutions are brainstormed collaboratively and delivered within deadlines, always having the people experience top of mind. We are humble but proud of the impact we have. This role reports directly to the Head of People Operations and Talent.  

The role in a nutshell:

As the Global Payroll & Reward Specialist, you will take end to end operational ownership of our global payroll ecosystem, compensation architecture, and total rewards frameworks. You are the operational engine and custodian of calculation precision across all operating entities. You will lead the accuracy of gross to net calculations, variance reconciliations, and regulatory compliance before packages are submitted for approval.

Beyond core payroll delivery, you will lead our compensation review cycles, manage variable pay and operational standby models, elevate and future proof our global reward proposition in a progressive, fast-paced tech environment.

Maintain living Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and runbooks to keep processes continuously audit-ready, actively exploring progressive tech solutions/AI to automate manual touchpoints and optimise system integrations and payments. 

Your mission will be:

Our core focus allocation reflects current operational priorities and may adapt dynamically based on business growth: 60% Global Payroll Operations, 20% Compensation Strategy, and 20% Reward.

- Global Payroll Operations, Governance & Accuracy (60%):

  • Multi Country Payroll Delivery: Manage the full monthly payroll cycle across all regions including South East Asia, Africa and Europe.
  • Accuracy Custodianship & Reconciliation: Take direct responsibility for calculation integrity, system inputs, and gross-to-net reconciliations prior to sign-off submissions. 
  • Finance & Treasury Partnership: Partner with the Finance team to distribute global salary payments in accordance with the payroll calendar, preparing payment schedules, journal files, and invoice packages in local currencies while tracking third-party deliverables. 
  • Statutory Compliance & Filings: Guarantee strict compliance with statutory reporting, deductions, and withholdings globally, including SARS (EMP201, EMP501, IT88 garnishees), UIF, and COIDA in South Africa; HMRC (RTI, P30, retrenchment tax rules) in the UK; LHDM and annual CPA22/CP22 tax clearances in Malaysia; and BPJS Health/Social Security alongside PIT obligations in Indonesia.
  • Vendor Governance & Annual SLA Reviews: Maintain operational governance over third-party’s and platform partners, enforcing SLAs, managing monthly input files and leading comprehensive annual third party service reviews.
  • Audit Readiness & Continuous Evolution: Maintain living Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and runbooks to keep processes continuously audit-ready, actively exploring progressive tech solutions to automate manual touchpoints and optimise system integrations.
  • Global Query Resolution: Serve as the authoritative, empathetic main point of contact for payroll queries. 

- Compensation Strategy, Analytics & Variable Pay (20%):

  • Salary Refresh Cycles: Lead the data modeling and operational rollout of the global compensation review, partnering with People Partners and Finance to build merit matrices and calculate currency-specific budget impacts.
  • Salary Architecture & Benchmarking: Maintain structured salary bands, leveling frameworks, and compa-ratio dashboards against tech industry market benchmarks to safeguard internal equity and external competitiveness.
  • Variable Pay & Allowances: Manage and calculate company incentive schemes, discretionary bonuses, and operational standby policies.
  • Workforce Spend Analytics: Deliver regular management reports detailing total workforce costs, fixed vs. variable pay splits, and currency risk exposure to inform headcount and financial forecasting.

- Reward Strategy (20%):

  • Market Parity & Harmonisation: Benchmark regional benefit packages against top-tier tech standards to drive equitable total reward value across direct entities and EOR arrangements.
  • Global Benefits Management: Oversee provider administration, enrollments, and monthly premium reconciliations for company schemes.
  • Reward Principles & Compliance: Own the company’s reward principles and pay philosophy as well as ensuring that the company is compliant with market developments such as pay transparency.

A little about you:

  • Experience & Scope: 7+ years of specialised Payroll, Compensation and Reward experience managing complex, multi-country payroll and reward operations for a distributed workforce of 400+ employees.
  • Regional Jurisdictional Expertise: Demonstrated hands-on operational knowledge of statutory payroll, tax compliance, and benefit regulations in South Africa and the United Kingdom, with direct exposure to Southeast Asian markets (Malaysia and/or Indonesia) and global Employer of Record (EOR) models.
  • Project Management: 3+ years of project management experience leading system implementations, process overhauls, or annual compensation and audit initiatives.
  • Uncompromising Accuracy: High accountability and personal pride in calculation precision, with an instinct for reconciliation integrity and catching variances before final review.
  • Analytical Acumen: Highly numerate with advanced spreadsheet skills (Google Sheets / Microsoft Excel), including complex nested formulas, pivot tables, gross-to-net reconciliations, and multi-currency modeling.
  • Self-Starter & Progressive Mindset: Comfortable navigating changes in an evolving tech environment, energised by automation, and proactive in researching cross-border employment tax and labour codes without waiting for direction.
  • Collaborative Communicator: People first approach with excellent communication skills, able to explain complex payroll, pension, and reward concepts clearly to global teams and senior stakeholders.
  • Education & Credentials: A tertiary qualification in Finance, Accountancy, Commerce, Human Resources, or equivalent practical experience. Industry certifications (e.g., CIPP, GRP, CCP, or regional payroll accreditations) are a distinct plus.

About the Team

The Financial Crime Quality Assurance (QA) team at OKX is part of the Compliance Assurance function and is responsible for reviewing and rating the quality of AML Transaction Monitoring alert disposition and Financial Crime Investigations performed by the Global Financial Crime Investigations Team.
We are a team of risk-focused compliance experts who independently assess investigation quality, promote consistency in decision-making, and ensure compliance with AML/CFT requirements, internal policies, and regulatory expectations. By working closely with Operations, Product, and Compliance teams, we help strengthen financial crime controls and drive continuous improvement across the investigation lifecycle.

About the Opportunity

This is an exciting opportunity to lead the Financial Crime QA team within the Compliance Assurance function of a regulated crypto business. As QA Team Lead, you will manage a team of QA Analysts who review AML Transaction Monitoring alerts, Name Screening, EDD and other financial crime investigations.
You will own the day-to-day delivery and quality of the QA program, set and uphold review standards, and develop your team's expertise. Working closely with Financial Crime Operations, Compliance leadership and Product teams, you will turn QA insights into lasting improvements in investigation quality and the effectiveness of the firm's financial crime controls.
 
 

What You’ll Be Doing

    • Team Leadership & People Management – Lead, mentor and develop a team of QA Analysts. Set clear objectives, allocate daily workload, manage capacity and productivity, and conduct regular one-to-ones and performance reviews. Support hiring, onboarding and training of new team members, and foster a culture of accountability, integrity and continuous learning.
    • QA Program Ownership – Own the end-to-end delivery of QA reviews across Transaction Monitoring, Name Screening, Sanctions, EDD and other AML investigations. Ensure reviews are completed on time, to a consistent standard, and in line with agreed sampling plans and service levels.
    • Quality Oversight & Second-Level Review – Perform second-level reviews of QA Analyst findings, validate defect ratings and resolve disputes or challenges from Operations. Personally review complex, high-risk or escalated cases, and act as the final QA decision-maker on borderline outcomes.
    • QA Framework & Methodology – Design, maintain and enhance the QA framework, including scorecards, error taxonomies, risk-based sampling methodologies, procedures and quality standards. Ensure the framework reflects AML/CFT regulatory requirements, internal policies, and emerging crypto-specific typologies.
    • Calibration & Consistency – Lead regular calibration sessions within the QA team and with Financial Crime Operations to align on policy interpretation, grey areas and scoring methodology, and reduce subjectivity in quality evaluations.
    • Management Information & Reporting – Produce and present QA MI, dashboards and trend analysis to Financial Crime and Compliance leadership. Identify systemic issues, root causes and emerging risks, and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations for management and governance forums.
    • Stakeholder Management – Act as the primary QA point of contact for Financial Crime Operations leadership, Team Leads, Product, Policy and other Compliance teams. Drive agreement on corrective actions, escalate material control weaknesses, and support internal and external audits and regulatory examinations as required.
    • Coaching & Quality Improvement – Partner with Operations and Training teams to turn QA findings into targeted coaching, training content and procedural updates. Act as a Subject Matter Expert on AML investigations, crypto typologies and regulatory expectations.
    • Innovation & AI-Enabled Quality – Drive the adoption and continuous improvement of AI-enabled quality tools such as QA Copilot. Define requirements, lead UAT and process validation, and identify opportunities to increase QA coverage and efficiency through automation.
    • AML Projects & Program Enhancements – Represent QA in AML projects, process changes and program enhancement initiatives, providing input on control design, quality standards and implementation readiness.
    • Ad Hoc Responsibilities – Undertake additional projects and assignments as delegated by the Head of Compliance Assurance or their delegate.
     
 

What We Look For In You

    • Bachelor's degree in law, finance, business administration or a related field; a relevant compliance certification (e.g. CAMS, ICA) is strongly preferred
    • 10+ years of experience in the financial services industry, with a significant focus on AML/CFT and financial crime compliance
    • Experience in the cryptocurrency or digital asset industry is highly preferred, including familiarity with blockchain analytics tools (e.g. Chainalysis, Elliptic, TRM Labs) and crypto-specific financial crime typologies
    • Proven hands-on experience in AML Transaction Monitoring and Financial Crime Investigations, including alert disposition, case investigation, and SAR/STR decisioning
    • Demonstrated people leadership experience, including managing, coaching and developing teams of analysts or investigators
    • Experience in Quality Assurance and/or Monitoring & Testing of AML controls is highly desirable, including designing scorecards, sampling methodologies and QA frameworks
    • Strong understanding of global AML/CFT regulatory expectations and sanctions requirements
    • Excellent analytical and judgment skills, with the ability to identify root causes and systemic issues and translate them into practical recommendations
    • Strong stakeholder management skills and the confidence to challenge, influence and drive agreement with senior stakeholders
    • Experience producing management information and presenting findings to leadership or governance forums

Own Your Intelligence

 

Prime Intellect is building the open superintelligence stack: the infrastructure frontier AI labs build internally, made available to every ambitious AI team.

We are building open frontier AI: open-source models trained end to end for long-horizon tasks like autonomous research, and the full-stack platform our own research team uses to build them. The next generation of AI companies, enterprises, and research teams do not just need more GPUs. They need the ability to turn their own workflows, tools, data, and feedback loops into superintelligence they own.

 

Prime Intellect has raised $150M in total funding from Founders Fund, Radical Ventures, NVIDIA, and exceptional AI, infrastructure, and enterprise operators — including Andrej Karpathy, Dwarkesh Patel, and leaders and founders from Ramp, Perplexity, Harvey, Mercor, Zapier, Datadog, Cognition, OpenAI, Thinking Machines, Together AI, SemiAnalysis, LangChain, Browserbase, Cloudflare, Sierra, Databricks, Airbnb, OpenRouter, Standard Intelligence, Fleet, Core Auto, and more. We are looking for people who want to build at the intersection of frontier research, real infrastructure, and go-to-market for a category that does not fully exist yet.

Role Impact

Quantitative finance is a demanding setting for agentic reinforcement learning: observations are noisy and non-stationary, actions have delayed and path-dependent consequences, naive objectives invite exploitation, and a convincing historical result can disappear under costs, constraints, or a new regime. You will build environments, evaluations, agents, and post-training methods for quantitative research and systematic decision-making. We have active programs with quantitative funds and other finance teams. The work may span research agents, market and portfolio simulators, time-series reasoning, execution, risk, and the production feedback loops that connect hypotheses to deployed systems.

Responsibilities

Applied Research at Prime

We turn a workflow into tasks, environments, evaluations, and reward signals, run post-training experiments against real baselines, and deploy what works. When a result looks good, we find out whether the gain came from the model or from the data, harness, inference, or infrastructure. The reusable parts become shared research, open-source systems, and product capabilities.

Every Applied Research role is externally facing. Most researchers work directly with customers, users, or research partners while maintaining a substantive research agenda.

Representative early problems

  • Build a quantitative-research environment where an agent forms a hypothesis, writes and runs analysis, runs a backtest on point-in-time data, diagnoses the result, and decides what to test next.

  • Design rewards and evaluations that distinguish durable improvement from the artifacts of look-ahead bias, data leakage, overfitting, favorable execution assumptions, or hidden concentration and tail risk.

  • Train long-horizon agents to use data, research, coding, simulation, and portfolio tools while preserving provenance, respecting risk constraints, and adapting when market conditions change.

What you will own

  • Environments grounded in point-in-time data, realistic market mechanics, transaction costs, latency, capacity, and operational constraints.

  • Agents that conduct quantitative research, use analytical and execution tools, inspect their evidence, and recover from failed hypotheses.

  • Verifiers and evaluations that test robust out-of-sample behavior across assets, horizons, regimes, and adverse conditions.

  • Production loops with monitoring, human authority, regression gates, and failure attribution across models, data, simulation, and infrastructure, producing methods that transfer to other noisy, high-stakes decision systems.

Requirements

  • We are looking first for depth in RL, agents, or post-training systems and the ability to become fluent in quantitative research.

  • Prior work in systematic trading, market microstructure, time-series modeling, econometrics, or financial simulation is useful but not required.

  • Hands-on experience building and debugging model-training, post-training, agent, evaluation, or closely adjacent experimental loops.

  • Strong experimental judgment: meaningful baselines, careful trace inspection, clear failure attribution, and a willingness to change direction when the evidence changes.

  • Strong Python and the ability to build artifacts that other researchers and engineers can run, inspect, and extend.

  • Comfort owning ambiguous problems and keeping partners and teammates current as you resolve them.

Evidence of exceptional work

We value publications, open-source systems, benchmarks, and shipped products as evidence of exceptional work. Show us something difficult you built, what failed, and how the evidence changed your approach.

  • Flexible Work (San Francisco, New York, London, or remote)
